page.layout: One blank leaf of paper, with the gilt-tooled leather board of the binding framing its left edge. No printed text blocks. A small label at the upper left and faint pencil writing in the middle are not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from stains and a faint pencil note in the upper centre, which is handwriting and is not transcribed. At the upper left is a small label in capitals reading "HANS ASPER". It may be an ownership label or bookplate, not running text, so it is not transcribed here. The scan shows the binding's gilt tooled border and the edges of the boards.
